ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a sketch map of the distribution of export processing zones in China; the black dots are mainly concentrated in the eastern coastal areas; Jia is located in the western inland region, and Yi is located in the eastern coastal area, an area where export processing zones are relatively dense. Reasoning: The question requires comparing the advantage in terms of “regional development foundation,” so it should be judged from the level of regional economic development and industrial supporting conditions. Compared with the western inland region, China’s eastern coastal areas have a higher level of economic development, and their industrial foundation and supporting conditions are more complete; therefore, Yi’s advantage over Jia in regional development foundation is that its economic foundation is strong.
